    1. visit(A)

Schnittstelle Visitor<A>

Typparameter:
A - the type of elements accepted by this visitor
Funktionsschnittstelle:
Dies ist eine funktionale Schnittstelle, die somit als Zuweisungsziel für einen Lambdaausdruck oder eine Methodenreferenz verwendet werden kann.
@FunctionalInterface public interface Visitor<A>

Functional interface defining a visitor in the classic Visitor pattern. A visitor encapsulates an operation to be performed on a value of type A.

Implementations may perform side effects. Unless stated otherwise, visitors are not required to be idempotent or thread‑safe; concrete implementations should document their semantics.

  • Methodendetails

    • visit

      void visit(@NonNull A visitable)

      Visits the given element and performs the visitor’s operation on it.

      Contract: visitable must not be null. Implementations may perform side effects and should document any constraints (e.g., ordering or reentrancy).

      Parameter:
      visitable - the element to visit; must not be null
